method: 24 directions at2m path stations. Only named opaque walls/screens/building masses counted; proxies, rails, pipes, shrubs and signage excluded. Nearby cover is NOT the same as breaking forward sight. Open intervals are reset at actual path turns, not merged into a fictitious straight firing line. No enemy positions or bullet/material simulation.

south_gate_to_core.limitations: Nearby lateral shelter does not guarantee frontal crossfire protection; first-hit sampling may undercount cover behind pipes/rails
